INSERT INTO app.jogos (nome, plataforma, zerado, eu_queria)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    -- Converte pra boolean, tratando null e string vazia
    COALESCE(NULLIF($3, '')::BOOLEAN, FALSE),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($4, '')::BOOLEAN, FALSE)
)
RETURNING id, nome, zerado;

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN data < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'atrasado'
        WHEN data = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'hoje'
        WHEN data = CURRENT_DATE + 1 THEN 'amanha'
        WHEN data = CURRENT_DATE + 2 THEN 'depois'
    END AS grupo,
    id, titulo, descricao, data, hora, prioridade, categoria
FROM app.afazeres
WHERE status = 'pendente'
  AND data <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '2 days'
ORDER BY data, hora NULLS LAST, prioridade DESC;

parameters.query:
WITH claim AS (
    UPDATE app.bot_buffer
    SET processado = TRUE
    WHERE chat_id = $1
      AND processado = FALSE
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM app.bot_buffer b2
          WHERE b2.chat_id = $1
            AND b2.processado = FALSE
            AND b2.id > $2
      )
    RETURNING id, texto, created_at
)
SELECT * FROM claim ORDER BY id;
